exact_transport_validation.receipt_size_note: Original size was computed before comparison HTML/JSON were added; current complete estimate adds1975bytes and remains safely below1GiB. No failing size threshold was changed.

url_and_cache_scope: audio-compare.html AFTER href=./?audio_compare=after opens root HTML with fixed mainPack index.3866985a1e8b.pck; BEFORE href=audio-before/?audio_compare=before opens separate HTML with fixed index.2caa023125bd.pck. Query parameters label the comparison, not substitute versions.

Each folder carries its own original worker, resource/chunk map, build-info, HTML and complete matching engine/worklets. Actual metadata proves before source4707 and after sourceccc11; no?v-only version fiction.

Both pages register index.cache-sw.js relatively with no base tag or widened scope. Before worker scope is/audio-before/ and its fetch guard rejects URLs outside that origin/scope; it cannot intercept root after resources.

Root worker computes names relative to root scope, so audio-before/index... does not match the root RESOURCE_MAP or index-prefix fallback regex. Initial root control of a child page does not rewrite its child URLs; child registration/controller handoff is supported by existing handshake.
Worker handshake checks both worker ID and expected PCK name; update lookup uses build-info.json relative to each page. Both remain tied to their own build after reload.

CacheStorage namespace strings are shared by the existing worker design, but keys are full URLs including directories and content-addressed filenames, and hashes/sizes are verified. Cache eviction can affect download reuse, not switch a bundle into the other version. This review does not claim storage/save isolation.

findings: workflow_dispatch already exists onmain, so workflow discovery is available. Dispatch with --ref fix/mobile-web-performance-20261029 selects the branch workflow carrying audio-before reconstruction; dispatching defaultmain would run its older definition.
Checkout of helper uses github.sha for the selected run revision, then checks out inputs.prepared_ref into prepared-web. The fixed optional path has no user-controlled shell interpolation.

Root reconstruct-pack is mandatory; existing audio-before/build-info.json triggers the exact same helper against the child directory before upload-pages-artifact. Both full PCKs are reconstructed and checked by bytes, chunk hashes and full SHA.
Reconstruction helper uses standard library in this command path, matching sparse checkout of its one file. No hidden repository import/dependency is needed for reconstruct-pack.

Observed github-pages environment allows this branch with no deployment protection rules. Actual dispatch authorization/run completion and final Pages publication remain pending; read-only review did not initiate any run.

design_findings: Opens ordinary exported HTML and reads expected build/source metadata; no GDScript/PCK patch, alternate scene, playback override, Master-routing repair or engine/worklet replacement is introduced.

One ordered init script installs recorder interception, then a Blob URL holding observer-only formal_pcm_worklet.js, then graph observer and audio observer. Blob avoids service-worker-controlled external module fetch bypassing Playwright route interception.

The separate mobile-web-perf-pcm node receives a fan-out of observed destination branches and feeds a gain0sink. Original destination edges/gains/playback native calls remain; samples are copied to a bounded recorder and original Godot read/chunk messages are not rewritten.

Graph/source wrappers call original native operations, retain their return values/exceptions, and add metadata/observation only. No special Root/Master destination hook is loaded. Standard engine JS/WASM/worklets remain official hashes.
Input is ordinary touch at fitted-screen coordinates plus real Home menu Explore; report label separates audio output observation from any graphics/device acceptance.

Observers add some CPU/audio-graph overhead. They are browser-only instrumentation, not zero-cost or physical-speaker evidence. Closest-native-start proximity alone is not asset identity; template/variant evidence must accompany it.
standard_production_audio_observer.first_attempt: production-browser-audio-01 remains incomplete/failed; original report/title/log/stdout TimeoutError retained. The first module-route404 issue is not relabelled as success after the Blob fix.
standard_production_audio_observer.boundary: Reviewed existing root-produced PCM/match receipts, did not rerun or independently listen/analyze waveforms. These Home/Plains jump/pulse observations do not prove all cues, phone behavior or complete music/bed continuity.
